scenario: AITA for not inviting my boyfriend along when I hang out with my friends | This has been an ongoing argument between my boyfriend (M26) and I (F26) so we're bringing it to the internet to decide whether I'm being an asshole. He's read over what I'm writing and we're both going to accept the decision of internet strangers. For the record we live together. I have always believed that when I'm hanging out with friends I should make an effort to sometimes go alone. This refers both to when I'm hanging out one on one with a friend and when it's a small group of us (like 3-4 friends from high school). When it's a larger group I always invite him. My reasoning for this is: 1. Just because they want to hang out with me doesn't necessarily mean that they want to hang out with my boyfriend at that time (for the record they like him). I feel like there are things that they maybe wouldn't feel comfortable sharing if he was there. 2. Sometimes I feel like by bringing him I'm "rubbing in their face" or reminding them that they aren't in a relationship, and I know that some of them are actively looking. Also I remember how it felt when I was in their place and even though I was happy for them that they were happy I was also a little bit jealous and felt left out. 3. I think that a lot of times people get into relationships and lose touch with their friends. I remember how much it bothered me when I felt like I was losing my friend to a relationship or when they would invite me out but I felt like a 3rd wheel. It's important to me to keep making an effort in my friendships and not give my friends the feeling that they're "in addition to my boyfriend". 4. I feel like sometimes inviting my boyfriend changes the vibe of hanging out, and while that's totally fine, sometimes I feel like my friends want to just hang out "the high school friends" or "just girls". I feel like I also sometimes want this specific vibe. I remember how much it bothered me when I thought that I was hanging out with a friend and I showed up to see that her boyfriend had come along too, even if I liked him I was a little bit sad that we wouldn't have our own time together. Overall I love my boyfriend and things are great when he comes along, but I feel that it's important for me to sometimes prioritize just friend things. This came up again today because I mentioned that I was going to meet with a friend tomorrow and my boyfriend got pissed that I'm not inviting him yet again, and he thinks that I'm taking my friends into account more than him. AITA by not inviting him along? ​ TLDR boyfriend is offended that I want to hang out with a friend without inviting him, AITA?
